Operations & Systems Support Large-Scale Deployments

Supporting & Operating Large-Scale InterSystems IRIS

Specialized contract engineering and operational leadership for mission-critical InterSystems IRIS, HealthShare, and cloud-native Kubernetes workloads. Delivering high-availability mirroring, deep-dive performance diagnostics, and zero-downtime legacy modernizations.

Cloud-Native & IKO

InterSystems Kubernetes Operator (IKO)

Automated topology deployment, rolling upgrades, and cluster lifecycle management using custom IrisCluster resources.

  • • Declarative multi-node cluster topologies: mirrored data nodes, distributed caching via Enterprise Cache Protocol (ECP), and sharded analytics engines.
  • • GitOps continuous delivery with zero-downtime rolling upgrades and containerized maintenance workflows across any Kubernetes platform.
  • • Dynamic persistent volume management, CSI multi-volume storage layouts, and non-disruptive volume resizing.
  • • Enterprise Kubernetes orchestration on Google Cloud (GKE), AWS (EKS), Azure (AKS), and on-premise OpenShift/Kubernetes.
IKO IrisCluster ECP Sharding Kubernetes
HA & Mirroring

High Availability & Data Protection

Architected for continuous 24/7 database availability, split-brain protection, and zero data loss recovery.

  • • Synchronous failover mirroring paired with ISCAgent Arbiter for instant, automated failover without split-brain risk.
  • • Disaster recovery (DR) async nodes and reporting async members to offload heavy analytical queries from OLTP primary.
  • • Storage-grade zero-impact backups utilizing external Freeze/Thaw APIs (SYS.Database.Freeze/Thaw) for storage snapshot integration.
  • • Write Image Journal (WIJ) health monitoring, primary/alternate journal directory failover, and crash recovery safety.
Mirroring Arbiter Freeze/Thaw WIJ & Journals
System Administration

Performance Tuning & Diagnostics

Deep-dive diagnostic analysis and configuration tuning to maximize throughput and resolve resource contention.

  • • Diagnostic profiling and bottleneck isolation using ^SystemPerformance (pButtons), ^PERFMON, and messages.log telemetry.
  • • Configuration Parameter File (iris.cpf) optimization: tuning global buffers (globals), routine buffers, locks, and shared memory (gmheap).
  • • Process contention and concurrency management: lock table deadlock resolution (^LOCKTAB) and semaphore optimization.
  • • Scheduled database integrity audits (^Integrity), block allocation checks, and enterprise security hardening (RBAC & TLS).
^SystemPerformance iris.cpf Buffer Tuning ^Integrity
Staff Augmentation

Legacy Modernization & Support

Bridging technical talent gaps with senior operational leadership for mission-critical healthcare and enterprise IT.

  • • Low-risk migrations from legacy Caché, Ensemble, and MUMPS to modern InterSystems IRIS Data Platform & IRIS for Health.
  • • Production cutover planning, data reconciliation, interface verification (HealthShare & Health Connect), and go-live leadership.
  • • Fractional systems leadership: augmenting internal teams during high-stakes implementations, upgrades, and platform scaling.
  • • Rapid incident triage, 24/7 on-call escalation support, and root-cause remediation for production outages.
